Built inBuilt in properties are set by the Nova Angular component itself or by its parent. These properties are generally not needed to be set or edited.
'true' when determinate is false null when determinate is true
Hide progress from screen readers when true. By default, indeterminate progress is hidden and determinate progress is visible.
Marks progress as complete when true. By default, determinate progress is marked complete when value is greater than or equal to max, and indeterminate progress is never marked complete.
Sets progress to determinate when true.
Marks progress as invalid when true.
The max value for a determinate progress bar.
The current progress as a percentage (0-100). Use this for simple percentage-based progress.
The current progress value. Works with the max attribute to calculate percentage. Use when tracking progress with custom units (e.g., items processed out of a total).
Built inBuilt in properties are set by the Nova Angular component itself or by its parent. These properties are generally not needed to be set or edited.
Attribute set to the id of the element it's labeling. This property is set by default for radio and checkbox components when used within v-input-container as directed.
Swaps v-label class for v-progress-label when true. Intended for use when label is describing a progress component. Automatically set to true when used within a Circular Progress component.
